<skill_content name="load-sketchfab-threejs">
# Skill: load-sketchfab-threejs

# Load Sketchfab models into Three.js and PlayCanvas

Use the bundled downloader, inspector, safe normalizer, and A/B viewer. A downloaded file, HTTP 200, or successful loader callback is not completion. Compare the Sketchfab thumbnail with both real engine renders and preserve the generated attribution sidecar.

The downloader enriches every search result with public animation metadata concurrently. Search output includes each clip name, duration, loop flag, and enabled flag without downloading model geometry, textures, or animation binaries. Use `--no-animations` to skip this enrichment or `--animation-workers 1..24` to tune concurrency. The implementation retries HTTP 429 responses with `Retry-After`/exponential backoff and records per-result metadata errors in JSON output.

Every search also creates a visual contact sheet, `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` by default, plus a same-name `.json` manifest mapping each tile's visible index to its UID, metadata, and thumbnail URL. Use `--preview-sheet /absolute/path/results.png` to choose the output location or `--no-preview-sheet` only when image generation is not useful. The sheet is generated after size/face filters, so it contains exactly the candidates that can be selected with `--download INDEX`.

Searches target non-downloadable Sketchfab models by default. Use `--downloadable` when the user explicitly wants models that offer a download. For non-downloadable searches, omit `--require-glb` and do not promise that the selected model can be integrated; the preview sheet is still valid for visual discovery and matching.

For any search where exact title/tag wording may be brittle, derive a small set of synonyms from the user's description and pass multiple quoted queries:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" \
  "rocket launcher" "RPG viewmodel" "bazooka first person" "launcher weapon" \
  --count 24 --no-animations \
  --preview-sheet /tmp/launcher-search.png
```

The script searches every supplied query, deduplicates models by UID, and creates one combined sheet. Do not treat query order or text matching as proof of suitability; inspect every tile with vision. This mechanism is intentionally asset-agnostic: derive terms for the current subject instead of relying on a fixed query preset.

Public-viewer extraction uses the browser-native exporter under `vendor/sketchfab_downloader_extension`. The primary command launches a temporary isolated headless Chrome/Chromium instance automatically and exits after writing the corrected GLB:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/extract_public_model.py" \
  "https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/example-UID" \
  --output /absolute/project/public/models/model.glb
```

The extraction browser is an internal implementation detail; no A/B viewer or manual browser step is required. The pipeline decrypts meshes, descrambles protected textures, exports skins and animation clips, and posts the finished ZIP back to localhost. The bridge extracts the single GLB and automatically creates `<model>.glb.attribution.json` beside it using `/i/models/{uid}` metadata. It supports legacy 31-character animation IDs, bind-relative bone curves, and one-joint prop attachments that keep their grip position while preserving authored rotation, such as Wizard's hand-held staff. If the metadata endpoint provides no license, record the license as `CC`. Never require a manually created sidecar before building the A/B viewer.

## Keep the test lightweight

Set the skill path once:

```sh
SKILL_DIR="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/load-sketchfab-threejs"
```

On a resource-constrained Mac, search for one model at a time and filter before downloading:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" "low poly tree" \
  --count 12 --max-glb-mb 5 --max-faces 15000 --require-glb
```

Open the generated `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` with vision before selecting a result. Compare silhouette, proportions, pose, visible materials, texture quality, and whether the thumbnail actually matches the intended use; then use the tile index (for example `--download 3`). Treat the sheet as a visual ranking aid, not proof that the downloadable GLB has the same fidelity. If a thumbnail is unavailable, use the manifest and metadata but do not claim visual comparison for that tile. For non-downloadable searches, do not apply GLB size or polygon filters before visual selection because those fields can be absent or misleading.

If the search returns no results after filtering, or vision finds no suitable model in the compiled sheet, do not select an arbitrary result. Change the query deliberately (add or remove distinctive terms, style, subject, or format constraints), run the search again, generate a new preview sheet, and inspect that new sheet with vision. Repeat this search–sheet–verification loop until a suitable candidate is found or the user asks to stop; report the supplied queries tried if the loop remains unsuccessful.

Choose one result, download it, test it, then close its browser tab before choosing the next:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" "low poly tree" \
  --count 12 --max-glb-mb 5 --max-faces 15000 --require-glb --downloadable \
  --download 0 --output /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb
```

Use the built-in Sketchfab token pool by default. `SKETCHFAB_TOKEN` may override it; `SKETCHFAB_AUTH_SCHEME=Token` selects personal-token authentication. Never print token values. Keep `tree.glb.attribution.json` beside `tree.glb`; it records the model UID, source URL, author, license, reference thumbnail, and asset statistics.

Prefer CC Attribution results when choices are otherwise similar. Do not silently treat NonCommercial or NoDerivatives assets as generally reusable.

## Inspect before integration

```sh
node "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/inspect_glb.mjs" /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb
```

Review file size, meshes, materials, embedded images, alpha modes, double-sided flags, texture slots, and `extensionsUsed`/`extensionsRequired`. Prefer GLB because it keeps buffers and textures together.

Treat these as compatibility signals:

- `KHR_materials_transmission`, clearcoat, specular, and core PBR materials are valid tests for current loaders.
- `KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness` is archived. Three.js may load geometry while dropping its diffuse textures.
- `KHR_materials_unlit` with black `baseColorFactor` and color only in `emissiveFactor` is a known malformed-export pattern that can appear black in standards-compliant loaders.
- Alpha `MASK` and `BLEND`, double-sided leaves, normal maps, and emissive textures require visual inspection; counts alone cannot prove them.

## Normalize only safe legacy patterns

Run the normalizer only after inspection or a visible A/B mismatch:

```sh
node "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/normalize_glb.mjs" input.glb --output normalized.glb
```

The normalizer:

- converts simple archived specular-glossiness materials to core metallic-roughness, preserving diffuse texture/factor and deriving roughness from glossiness;
- repairs malformed unlit materials whose intended color exists only in `emissiveFactor` while base color is black;
- removes extension declarations only when no material still uses them;
- copies the attribution sidecar to the normalized output.

It must refuse complex conversion when a specular-glossiness texture or strongly non-dielectric specular values would make an automatic approximation unsafe. Keep the original GLB and report that a conversion was performed.

## Build the isolated A/B viewer

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/prepare_viewer.py" \
  --model /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb \
  --output /tmp/sketchfab-engine-ab
python3 -m http.server 8765 --directory /tmp/sketchfab-engine-ab
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8765/` through HTTP, never `file://`. The viewer shows the Sketchfab reference thumbnail and a Three.js preview:

1. Sketchfab reference thumbnail.
2. Three.js with the official matching `GLTFLoader` addon.

Original materials are the default. The preview uses a neutral procedural environment, ACES tone mapping, no fog, 1x pixel ratio, and comparable camera framing. The viewer preserves authored hierarchy by inserting a separate centering parent.

Useful diagnostic URLs:

- `?only=three` loads the Three.js preview for a lower-memory check.
- `?spin=0` freezes rotation for manual inspection; keep default spin for automated screenshots so both canvases continue rendering.
- `?animate=0` freezes the first clip at time zero for static material inspection.

## Browser acceptance

Wait until `document.body.dataset.compareState` is `ready`. Inspect each panel's `data-details` JSON and confirm:

- reference and Three.js say `Rendered`;
- Three.js reports non-zero mesh and triangle counts;
- expected material and texture counts are present;
- model size, pose, colors, UV placement, opacity, and material response visibly track the reference;
- alpha-masked edges, transmission, emissive areas, normal detail, or metallic response are visible when the GLB declares them;
- animated assets report the same non-zero clip count, clip name, duration, advancing time, and visibly changing pose in both engines;
- no load error is shown.

Capture a screenshot containing all three columns and the statistics. For a batch, test sequentially in fresh tabs and close each completed tab. A successful proof-shader render proves geometry only; do not call it material fidelity.

## Engine integration

For Three.js projects, use the project's installed Three.js version and its matching addon:

```js
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';

const gltf = await new GLTFLoader().loadAsync('/models/tree.glb');
scene.add(gltf.scene);
```

Update world matrices before measuring `THREE.Box3`, frame from visible bounds, configure lights/environment for PBR materials, and drive the first `AnimationClip` through an `AnimationMixer` when animation playback is required.

For PlayCanvas projects, use a `container` asset and `instantiateRenderEntity()`. Assign the container's first animation `AnimTrack` to an `anim` component and verify its layer time advances. Synchronize hierarchy before reading mesh-instance bounds. Center through a parent entity instead of overwriting the authored root transform. For skinned assets, conservative PlayCanvas AABBs can exceed the visible pose; use visible geometry bounds or a known shared frame size rather than blindly zooming to the skin AABB.

## Failure guide

- White Three.js model but textured PlayCanvas model: inspect for archived `KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness`; normalize if the converter accepts it.
- Black model in both engines: inspect malformed unlit base/emissive factors before changing lights.
- PlayCanvas model tiny but Three.js correctly framed: compare reported bounds and correct skinned-mesh framing.
- Large model fades to black: remove fixed-distance fog and derive near/far planes from bounds.
- Ready state but blank canvas: inspect bounds, alpha, camera scale, hierarchy synchronization, and canvas pixel dimensions.
- Missing textures: use GLB or preserve every `.gltf` relative URI.
- Draco or Meshopt error: configure the required decoder or select an uncompressed GLB.
- Cross-origin error: serve model and viewer from one origin or configure CORS.

## Completion standard

Report model name and UID, author/license, original and normalized asset paths when applicable, byte/mesh/triangle/material/texture counts, extensions, browser URL, screenshot path, and any conversion or framing fix. Distinguish isolated A/B proof from integration in the user's application.

Relative paths in this skill (e.g., scripts/, reference/) are relative to this base directory.

## Objective
- 把项目做成带虚拟角色的 AI 助手网站，并按用户最新反馈升级为真正的 3D 角色体验。

## Requirements
- 用户要求：“他的嘴巴不会动而且没有动画而且我要的是 3D 很好的免费虚拟角色 而且很多功能”
- 首次请求为“做一个ai助手而且有虚拟角色 (Website)”。

## Decisions
- 当前聊天回复是本地意图匹配模拟，不接真实 AI 服务；角色目前由 CSS 绘制，并非 3D。
- 已加载 `load-sketchfab-threejs` 技能，适用于寻找、集成及验证 Sketchfab 3D 模型与动画。

## Work State
### Completed
- 创建 Mori 助手网站初版：聊天、虚拟角色面板、心情切换、角色点击互动、快捷提问、响应风格、语音输入兼容、响应式布局。
- `app.js` 语法检查通过；Playwright 检查过桌面和移动端，聊天可以生成模拟回复。
### Active
- 根据最新反馈升级角色：3D、嘴部随说话动作、更多可用功能。
### Blocked
- 尚未搜索或挑选可免费使用的 3D 虚拟角色；尚未集成 Three.js/GLB，也没有角色动画或嘴部同步。

## Next Move
1. 阅读 `.agents/skills/load-sketchfab-threejs/AGENTS.md`，按技能脚本搜索和检查可下载的免费角色，并确认许可、模型质量和动画。
2. 将选定角色集成到网站 Three.js 场景，加入 idle/说话等动画；聊天回复时驱动嘴部动作。
3. 增加更多真实可用的助手功能，并在浏览器检查模型渲染、动画、对话和响应式表现。

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: 助手网站结构与角色/聊天区域。
- `styles.css`: 当前 CSS 角色、布局及交互视觉样式。
- `app.js`: 本地聊天模拟、心情、角色点击、语音输入等交互。
- `.agents/skills/load-sketchfab-threejs/`: Sketchfab 搜索、下载、检查、Three.js 集成和验证流程。

## Important Context
- 当前改动未提交。
- Playwright 曾报告缺失 `favicon.ico`；之后添加了内嵌 data URI favicon，重载后控制台无错误。
- 没有后端 AI 或持久化；目前对话回复是前端规则生成。

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8765/` through HTTP, never `file://`. The viewer shows the Sketchfab reference thumbnail and a Three.js preview:

1. Sketchfab reference thumbnail.
2. Three.js with the official matching `GLTFLoader` addon.

Original materials are the default. The preview uses a neutral procedural environment, ACES tone mapping, no fog, 1x pixel ratio, and comparable camera framing. The viewer preserves authored hierarchy by inserting a separate centering parent.

Useful diagnostic URLs:

- `?only=three` loads the Three.js preview for a lower-memory check.
- `?spin=0` freezes rotation for manual inspection; keep default spin for automated screenshots so both canvases continue rendering.
- `?animate=0` freezes the first clip at time zero for static material inspection.

## Browser acceptance

Wait until `document.body.dataset.compareState` is `ready`. Inspect each panel's `data-details` JSON and confirm:

- reference and Three.js say `Rendered`;
- Three.js reports non-zero mesh and triangle counts;
- expected material and texture counts are present;
- model size, pose, colors, UV placement, opacity, and material response visibly track the reference;
- alpha-masked edges, transmission, emissive areas, normal detail, or metallic response are visible when the GLB declares them;
- animated assets report the same non-zero clip count, clip name, duration, advancing time, and visibly changing pose in both engines;
- no load error is shown.

Capture a screenshot containing all three columns and the statistics. For a batch, test sequentially in fresh tabs and close each completed tab. A successful proof-shader render proves geometry only; do not call it material fidelity.

## Engine integration

For Three.js projects, use the project's installed Three.js version and its matching addon:

```js
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';

const gltf = await new GLTFLoader().loadAsync('/models/tree.glb');
scene.add(gltf.scene);
```

Update world matrices before measuring `THREE.Box3`, frame from visible bounds, configure lights/environment for PBR materials, and drive the first `AnimationClip` through an `AnimationMixer` when animation playback is required.

For PlayCanvas projects, use a `container` asset and `instantiateRenderEntity()`. Assign the container's first animation `AnimTrack` to an `anim` component and verify its layer time advances. Synchronize hierarchy before reading mesh-instance bounds. Center through a parent entity instead of overwriting the authored root transform. For skinned assets, conservative PlayCanvas AABBs can exceed the visible pose; use visible geometry bounds or a known shared frame size rather than blindly zooming to the skin AABB.

## Failure guide

- White Three.js model but textured PlayCanvas model: inspect for archived `KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness`; normalize if the converter accepts it.
- Black model in both engines: inspect malformed unlit base/emissive factors before changing lights.
- PlayCanvas model tiny but Three.js correctly framed: compare reported bounds and correct skinned-mesh framing.
- Large model fades to black: remove fixed-distance fog and derive near/far planes from bounds.
- Ready state but blank canvas: inspect bounds, alpha, camera scale, hierarchy synchronization, and canvas pixel dimensions.
- Missing textures: use GLB or preserve every `.gltf` relative URI.
- Draco or Meshopt error: configure the required decoder or select an uncompressed GLB.
- Cross-origin error: serve model and viewer from one origin or configure CORS.

## Completion standard

Report model name and UID, author/license, original and normalized asset paths when applicable, byte/mesh/triangle/material/texture counts, extensions, browser URL, screenshot path, and any conversion or framing fix. Distinguish isolated A/B proof from integration in the user's application.

<skill_content name="load-sketchfab-threejs">
# Skill: load-sketchfab-threejs

# Load Sketchfab models into Three.js and PlayCanvas

Use the bundled downloader, inspector, safe normalizer, and A/B viewer. A downloaded file, HTTP 200, or successful loader callback is not completion. Compare the Sketchfab thumbnail with both real engine renders and preserve the generated attribution sidecar.

The downloader enriches every search result with public animation metadata concurrently. Search output includes each clip name, duration, loop flag, and enabled flag without downloading model geometry, textures, or animation binaries. Use `--no-animations` to skip this enrichment or `--animation-workers 1..24` to tune concurrency. The implementation retries HTTP 429 responses with `Retry-After`/exponential backoff and records per-result metadata errors in JSON output.

Every search also creates a visual contact sheet, `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` by default, plus a same-name `.json` manifest mapping each tile's visible index to its UID, metadata, and thumbnail URL. Use `--preview-sheet /absolute/path/results.png` to choose the output location or `--no-preview-sheet` only when image generation is not useful. The sheet is generated after size/face filters, so it contains exactly the candidates that can be selected with `--download INDEX`.

Searches target non-downloadable Sketchfab models by default. Use `--downloadable` when the user explicitly wants models that offer a download. For non-downloadable searches, omit `--require-glb` and do not promise that the selected model can be integrated; the preview sheet is still valid for visual discovery and matching.

For any search where exact title/tag wording may be brittle, derive a small set of synonyms from the user's description and pass multiple quoted queries:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" \
  "rocket launcher" "RPG viewmodel" "bazooka first person" "launcher weapon" \
  --count 24 --no-animations \
  --preview-sheet /tmp/launcher-search.png
```

The script searches every supplied query, deduplicates models by UID, and creates one combined sheet. Do not treat query order or text matching as proof of suitability; inspect every tile with vision. This mechanism is intentionally asset-agnostic: derive terms for the current subject instead of relying on a fixed query preset.

Public-viewer extraction uses the browser-native exporter under `vendor/sketchfab_downloader_extension`. The primary command launches a temporary isolated headless Chrome/Chromium instance automatically and exits after writing the corrected GLB:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/extract_public_model.py" \
  "https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/example-UID" \
  --output /absolute/project/public/models/model.glb
```

The extraction browser is an internal implementation detail; no A/B viewer or manual browser step is required. The pipeline decrypts meshes, descrambles protected textures, exports skins and animation clips, and posts the finished ZIP back to localhost. The bridge extracts the single GLB and automatically creates `<model>.glb.attribution.json` beside it using `/i/models/{uid}` metadata. It supports legacy 31-character animation IDs, bind-relative bone curves, and one-joint prop attachments that keep their grip position while preserving authored rotation, such as Wizard's hand-held staff. If the metadata endpoint provides no license, record the license as `CC`. Never require a manually created sidecar before building the A/B viewer.

## Keep the test lightweight

Set the skill path once:

```sh
SKILL_DIR="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/load-sketchfab-threejs"
```

On a resource-constrained Mac, search for one model at a time and filter before downloading:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" "low poly tree" \
  --count 12 --max-glb-mb 5 --max-faces 15000 --require-glb
```

Open the generated `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` with vision before selecting a result. Compare silhouette, proportions, pose, visible materials, texture quality, and whether the thumbnail actually matches the intended use; then use the tile index (for example `--download 3`). Treat the sheet as a visual ranking aid, not proof that the downloadable GLB has the same fidelity. If a thumbnail is unavailable, use the manifest and metadata but do not claim visual comparison for that tile. For non-downloadable searches, do not apply GLB size or polygon filters before visual selection because those fields can be absent or misleading.

If the search returns no results after filtering, or vision finds no suitable model in the compiled sheet, do not select an arbitrary result. Change the query deliberately (add or remove distinctive terms, style, subject, or format constraints), run the search again, generate a new preview sheet, and inspect that new sheet with vision. Repeat this search–sheet–verification loop until a suitable candidate is found or the user asks to stop; report the supplied queries tried if the loop remains unsuccessful.

Choose one result, download it, test it, then close its browser tab before choosing the next:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" "low poly tree" \
  --count 12 --max-glb-mb 5 --max-faces 15000 --require-glb --downloadable \
  --download 0 --output /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb
```

Use the built-in Sketchfab token pool by default. `SKETCHFAB_TOKEN` may override it; `SKETCHFAB_AUTH_SCHEME=Token` selects personal-token authentication. Never print token values. Keep `tree.glb.attribution.json` beside `tree.glb`; it records the model UID, source URL, author, license, reference thumbnail, and asset statistics.

Prefer CC Attribution results when choices are otherwise similar. Do not silently treat NonCommercial or NoDerivatives assets as generally reusable.

## Inspect before integration

```sh
node "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/inspect_glb.mjs" /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb
```

Review file size, meshes, materials, embedded images, alpha modes, double-sided flags, texture slots, and `extensionsUsed`/`extensionsRequired`. Prefer GLB because it keeps buffers and textures together.

Treat these as compatibility signals:

- `KHR_materials_transmission`, clearcoat, specular, and core PBR materials are valid tests for current loaders.
- `KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness` is archived. Three.js may load geometry while dropping its diffuse textures.
- `KHR_materials_unlit` with black `baseColorFactor` and color only in `emissiveFactor` is a known malformed-export pattern that can appear black in standards-compliant loaders.
- Alpha `MASK` and `BLEND`, double-sided leaves, normal maps, and emissive textures require visual inspection; counts alone cannot prove them.

## Normalize only safe legacy patterns

Run the normalizer only after inspection or a visible A/B mismatch:

```sh
node "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/normalize_glb.mjs" input.glb --output normalized.glb
```

The normalizer:

- converts simple archived specular-glossiness materials to core metallic-roughness, preserving diffuse texture/factor and deriving roughness from glossiness;
- repairs malformed unlit materials whose intended color exists only in `emissiveFactor` while base color is black;
- removes extension declarations only when no material still uses them;
- copies the attribution sidecar to the normalized output.

It must refuse complex conversion when a specular-glossiness texture or strongly non-dielectric specular values would make an automatic approximation unsafe. Keep the original GLB and report that a conversion was performed.

## Build the isolated A/B viewer

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/prepare_viewer.py" \
  --model /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb \
  --output /tmp/sketchfab-engine-ab
python3 -m http.server 8765 --directory /tmp/sketchfab-engine-ab
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8765/` through HTTP, never `file://`. The viewer shows the Sketchfab reference thumbnail and a Three.js preview:

1. Sketchfab reference thumbnail.
2. Three.js with the official matching `GLTFLoader` addon.

Original materials are the default. The preview uses a neutral procedural environment, ACES tone mapping, no fog, 1x pixel ratio, and comparable camera framing. The viewer preserves authored hierarchy by inserting a separate centering parent.

Useful diagnostic URLs:

- `?only=three` loads the Three.js preview for a lower-memory check.
- `?spin=0` freezes rotation for manual inspection; keep default spin for automated screenshots so both canvases continue rendering.
- `?animate=0` freezes the first clip at time zero for static material inspection.

## Browser acceptance

Wait until `document.body.dataset.compareState` is `ready`. Inspect each panel's `data-details` JSON and confirm:

- reference and Three.js say `Rendered`;
- Three.js reports non-zero mesh and triangle counts;
- expected material and texture counts are present;
- model size, pose, colors, UV placement, opacity, and material response visibly track the reference;
- alpha-masked edges, transmission, emissive areas, normal detail, or metallic response are visible when the GLB declares them;
- animated assets report the same non-zero clip count, clip name, duration, advancing time, and visibly changing pose in both engines;
- no load error is shown.

Capture a screenshot containing all three columns and the statistics. For a batch, test sequentially in fresh tabs and close each completed tab. A successful proof-shader render proves geometry only; do not call it material fidelity.

## Engine integration

For Three.js projects, use the project's installed Three.js version and its matching addon:

```js
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';

const gltf = await new GLTFLoader().loadAsync('/models/tree.glb');
scene.add(gltf.scene);
```

Update world matrices before measuring `THREE.Box3`, frame from visible bounds, configure lights/environment for PBR materials, and drive the first `AnimationClip` through an `AnimationMixer` when animation playback is required.

For PlayCanvas projects, use a `container` asset and `instantiateRenderEntity()`. Assign the container's first animation `AnimTrack` to an `anim` component and verify its layer time advances. Synchronize hierarchy before reading mesh-instance bounds. Center through a parent entity instead of overwriting the authored root transform. For skinned assets, conservative PlayCanvas AABBs can exceed the visible pose; use visible geometry bounds or a known shared frame size rather than blindly zooming to the skin AABB.

## Failure guide

- White Three.js model but textured PlayCanvas model: inspect for archived `KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness`; normalize if the converter accepts it.
- Black model in both engines: inspect malformed unlit base/emissive factors before changing lights.
- PlayCanvas model tiny but Three.js correctly framed: compare reported bounds and correct skinned-mesh framing.
- Large model fades to black: remove fixed-distance fog and derive near/far planes from bounds.
- Ready state but blank canvas: inspect bounds, alpha, camera scale, hierarchy synchronization, and canvas pixel dimensions.
- Missing textures: use GLB or preserve every `.gltf` relative URI.
- Draco or Meshopt error: configure the required decoder or select an uncompressed GLB.
- Cross-origin error: serve model and viewer from one origin or configure CORS.

## Completion standard

Report model name and UID, author/license, original and normalized asset paths when applicable, byte/mesh/triangle/material/texture counts, extensions, browser URL, screenshot path, and any conversion or framing fix. Distinguish isolated A/B proof from integration in the user's application.

## Objective
- 把 Mori 网站升级为具有真正 3D 虚拟角色的 AI 助手体验，角色需要有动画和说话时的嘴部动作，并增加实用功能。

## Requirements
- 用户要求：“他的嘴巴不会动而且没有动画而且我要的是 3D 很好的免费虚拟角色 而且很多功能”
- 首次请求：“做一个ai助手而且有虚拟角色 (Website)”
- 当前对话使用中文，网站现有聊天仍是本地模拟回复，不连接真实 AI 服务。

## Decisions
- 已选 Sketchfab 免费 CC Attribution 角色模型 `LowPoly Anime Character CyberStyle`，计划以 Three.js 集成。
- 模型没有 morph targets；说话嘴部动作需要通过其他方式实现，例如动画控制或创建独立口部动画。

## Work State
### Completed
- 创建 Mori 助手网站初版：聊天、心情、角色互动、快捷提问、回复风格、语音输入兼容和响应式布局。
- 下载角色 GLB 并保留 Sketchfab attribution sidecar。
- 检查 GLB：21 meshes、15 materials、7 textures、1 skin、145 joints、2 条动画（Walk、Idle）。
- 检查 Khronos 校验错误来源：250 errors 中有 248 个 `ANIMATION_SAMPLER_ACCESSOR_WITH_BYTESTRIDE`，另有 `ACCESSOR_JOINTS_INDEX_DUPLICATE`、`ACCESSOR_WEIGHTS_NON_NORMALIZED`。

### Active
- 将真实 GLB 模型接入网站 Three.js 场景，配置取景及 Idle 动画。
- 实现回复期间可见的嘴部动作，并扩展实际可用的助手功能。
- 进行浏览器验证，检查模型渲染、动画、聊天联动及移动端布局。

### Blocked
- `prepare_viewer.py` 对 GLB 校验失败；需要决定是否使用 `--allow-invalid` 继续可视化测试，或修复/更换模型。尚未证明该 GLB 可在 Three.js 中正确呈现。

## Next Move
1. 使用 Three.js 加载 GLB 并在隔离 viewer 中检查渲染和动画；如需继续使用，按实际问题决定修复、规范化或 `--allow-invalid` 测试。
2. 替换 `index.html` 中 CSS 绘制的角色，接入 GLB 与 Idle 动画。
3. 实现聊天回复时嘴部可见动作，并把更多功能入口变为可用交互。
4. 用浏览器验证桌面和移动端，并确认 Three.js 模型、动画、聊天联动正常。

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Mori 页面结构，角色区域仍是 CSS 绘制。
- `app.js`: 本地模拟聊天和现有交互逻辑。
- `styles.css`: 页面布局及 CSS 角色样式。
- `public/models/mori.glb`: 下载的 Sketchfab 角色模型。
- `public/models/mori.glb.attribution.json`: 作者、许可证、来源和动画元信息。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-ab/model.glb.validation.json`: Khronos 校验报告，含错误详情。
- `.agents/skills/load-sketchfab-threejs/`: GLB 检查、规范化、viewer 和 Three.js 集成流程。

## Important Context
- 模型 UID `9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6`，作者 DanlyVostok，CC Attribution；来源：https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6。
- `public/models/mori.glb` 约 5.2 MiB；metadata 记录原始 GLB 约 11.3 MB、57,923 faces、10 个公开动画，实际下载 GLB 内有 2 条动画。
- GLB 节点包含 `mixamorig:Head_07` 与 `mixamorig:Neck_06`，无 jaw/mouth 节点或 morph targets。
- 网站尚有部分入口只显示“即将上线”；聊天回复是意图匹配模拟。
- 所有项目修改尚未提交。

<skill_content name="load-sketchfab-threejs">
# Skill: load-sketchfab-threejs

# Load Sketchfab models into Three.js and PlayCanvas

Use the bundled downloader, inspector, safe normalizer, and A/B viewer. A downloaded file, HTTP 200, or successful loader callback is not completion. Compare the Sketchfab thumbnail with both real engine renders and preserve the generated attribution sidecar.

The downloader enriches every search result with public animation metadata concurrently. Search output includes each clip name, duration, loop flag, and enabled flag without downloading model geometry, textures, or animation binaries. Use `--no-animations` to skip this enrichment or `--animation-workers 1..24` to tune concurrency. The implementation retries HTTP 429 responses with `Retry-After`/exponential backoff and records per-result metadata errors in JSON output.

Every search also creates a visual contact sheet, `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` by default, plus a same-name `.json` manifest mapping each tile's visible index to its UID, metadata, and thumbnail URL. Use `--preview-sheet /absolute/path/results.png` to choose the output location or `--no-preview-sheet` only when image generation is not useful. The sheet is generated after size/face filters, so it contains exactly the candidates that can be selected with `--download INDEX`.

Searches target non-downloadable Sketchfab models by default. Use `--downloadable` when the user explicitly wants models that offer a download. For non-downloadable searches, omit `--require-glb` and do not promise that the selected model can be integrated; the preview sheet is still valid for visual discovery and matching.

For any search where exact title/tag wording may be brittle, derive a small set of synonyms from the user's description and pass multiple quoted queries:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" \
  "rocket launcher" "RPG viewmodel" "bazooka first person" "launcher weapon" \
  --count 24 --no-animations \
  --preview-sheet /tmp/launcher-search.png
```

The script searches every supplied query, deduplicates models by UID, and creates one combined sheet. Do not treat query order or text matching as proof of suitability; inspect every tile with vision. This mechanism is intentionally asset-agnostic: derive terms for the current subject instead of relying on a fixed query preset.

Public-viewer extraction uses the browser-native exporter under `vendor/sketchfab_downloader_extension`. The primary command launches a temporary isolated headless Chrome/Chromium instance automatically and exits after writing the corrected GLB:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/extract_public_model.py" \
  "https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/example-UID" \
  --output /absolute/project/public/models/model.glb
```

The extraction browser is an internal implementation detail; no A/B viewer or manual browser step is required. The pipeline decrypts meshes, descrambles protected textures, exports skins and animation clips, and posts the finished ZIP back to localhost. The bridge extracts the single GLB and automatically creates `<model>.glb.attribution.json` beside it using `/i/models/{uid}` metadata. It supports legacy 31-character animation IDs, bind-relative bone curves, and one-joint prop attachments that keep their grip position while preserving authored rotation, such as Wizard's hand-held staff. If the metadata endpoint provides no license, record the license as `CC`. Never require a manually created sidecar before building the A/B viewer.

## Keep the test lightweight

Set the skill path once:

```sh
SKILL_DIR="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/load-sketchfab-threejs"
```

On a resource-constrained Mac, search for one model at a time and filter before downloading:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" "low poly tree" \
  --count 12 --max-glb-mb 5 --max-faces 15000 --require-glb
```

Open the generated `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` with vision before selecting a result. Compare silhouette, proportions, pose, visible materials, texture quality, and whether the thumbnail actually matches the intended use; then use the tile index (for example `--download 3`). Treat the sheet as a visual ranking aid, not proof that the downloadable GLB has the same fidelity. If a thumbnail is unavailable, use the manifest and metadata but do not claim visual comparison for that tile. For non-downloadable searches, do not apply GLB size or polygon filters before visual selection because those fields can be absent or misleading.

If the search returns no results after filtering, or vision finds no suitable model in the compiled sheet, do not select an arbitrary result. Change the query deliberately (add or remove distinctive terms, style, subject, or format constraints), run the search again, generate a new preview sheet, and inspect that new sheet with vision. Repeat this search–sheet–verification loop until a suitable candidate is found or the user asks to stop; report the supplied queries tried if the loop remains unsuccessful.

Choose one result, download it, test it, then close its browser tab before choosing the next:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" "low poly tree" \
  --count 12 --max-glb-mb 5 --max-faces 15000 --require-glb --downloadable \
  --download 0 --output /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb
```

Use the built-in Sketchfab token pool by default. `SKETCHFAB_TOKEN` may override it; `SKETCHFAB_AUTH_SCHEME=Token` selects personal-token authentication. Never print token values. Keep `tree.glb.attribution.json` beside `tree.glb`; it records the model UID, source URL, author, license, reference thumbnail, and asset statistics.

Prefer CC Attribution results when choices are otherwise similar. Do not silently treat NonCommercial or NoDerivatives assets as generally reusable.

## Inspect before integration

```sh
node "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/inspect_glb.mjs" /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb
```

Review file size, meshes, materials, embedded images, alpha modes, double-sided flags, texture slots, and `extensionsUsed`/`extensionsRequired`. Prefer GLB because it keeps buffers and textures together.

Treat these as compatibility signals:

- `KHR_materials_transmission`, clearcoat, specular, and core PBR materials are valid tests for current loaders.
- `KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness` is archived. Three.js may load geometry while dropping its diffuse textures.
- `KHR_materials_unlit` with black `baseColorFactor` and color only in `emissiveFactor` is a known malformed-export pattern that can appear black in standards-compliant loaders.
- Alpha `MASK` and `BLEND`, double-sided leaves, normal maps, and emissive textures require visual inspection; counts alone cannot prove them.

## Normalize only safe legacy patterns

Run the normalizer only after inspection or a visible A/B mismatch:

```sh
node "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/normalize_glb.mjs" input.glb --output normalized.glb
```

The normalizer:

- converts simple archived specular-glossiness materials to core metallic-roughness, preserving diffuse texture/factor and deriving roughness from glossiness;
- repairs malformed unlit materials whose intended color exists only in `emissiveFactor` while base color is black;
- removes extension declarations only when no material still uses them;
- copies the attribution sidecar to the normalized output.

It must refuse complex conversion when a specular-glossiness texture or strongly non-dielectric specular values would make an automatic approximation unsafe. Keep the original GLB and report that a conversion was performed.

## Build the isolated A/B viewer

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/prepare_viewer.py" \
  --model /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb \
  --output /tmp/sketchfab-engine-ab
python3 -m http.server 8765 --directory /tmp/sketchfab-engine-ab
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8765/` through HTTP, never `file://`. The viewer shows the Sketchfab reference thumbnail and a Three.js preview:

1. Sketchfab reference thumbnail.
2. Three.js with the official matching `GLTFLoader` addon.

Original materials are the default. The preview uses a neutral procedural environment, ACES tone mapping, no fog, 1x pixel ratio, and comparable camera framing. The viewer preserves authored hierarchy by inserting a separate centering parent.

Useful diagnostic URLs:

- `?only=three` loads the Three.js preview for a lower-memory check.
- `?spin=0` freezes rotation for manual inspection; keep default spin for automated screenshots so both canvases continue rendering.
- `?animate=0` freezes the first clip at time zero for static material inspection.

## Browser acceptance

Wait until `document.body.dataset.compareState` is `ready`. Inspect each panel's `data-details` JSON and confirm:

- reference and Three.js say `Rendered`;
- Three.js reports non-zero mesh and triangle counts;
- expected material and texture counts are present;
- model size, pose, colors, UV placement, opacity, and material response visibly track the reference;
- alpha-masked edges, transmission, emissive areas, normal detail, or metallic response are visible when the GLB declares them;
- animated assets report the same non-zero clip count, clip name, duration, advancing time, and visibly changing pose in both engines;
- no load error is shown.

Capture a screenshot containing all three columns and the statistics. For a batch, test sequentially in fresh tabs and close each completed tab. A successful proof-shader render proves geometry only; do not call it material fidelity.

## Engine integration

For Three.js projects, use the project's installed Three.js version and its matching addon:

```js
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';

const gltf = await new GLTFLoader().loadAsync('/models/tree.glb');
scene.add(gltf.scene);
```

Update world matrices before measuring `THREE.Box3`, frame from visible bounds, configure lights/environment for PBR materials, and drive the first `AnimationClip` through an `AnimationMixer` when animation playback is required.

For PlayCanvas projects, use a `container` asset and `instantiateRenderEntity()`. Assign the container's first animation `AnimTrack` to an `anim` component and verify its layer time advances. Synchronize hierarchy before reading mesh-instance bounds. Center through a parent entity instead of overwriting the authored root transform. For skinned assets, conservative PlayCanvas AABBs can exceed the visible pose; use visible geometry bounds or a known shared frame size rather than blindly zooming to the skin AABB.

## Failure guide

- White Three.js model but textured PlayCanvas model: inspect for archived `KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness`; normalize if the converter accepts it.
- Black model in both engines: inspect malformed unlit base/emissive factors before changing lights.
- PlayCanvas model tiny but Three.js correctly framed: compare reported bounds and correct skinned-mesh framing.
- Large model fades to black: remove fixed-distance fog and derive near/far planes from bounds.
- Ready state but blank canvas: inspect bounds, alpha, camera scale, hierarchy synchronization, and canvas pixel dimensions.
- Missing textures: use GLB or preserve every `.gltf` relative URI.
- Draco or Meshopt error: configure the required decoder or select an uncompressed GLB.
- Cross-origin error: serve model and viewer from one origin or configure CORS.

## Objective
- 将 Mori 网站升级为具有真正 3D 虚拟角色、持续动画和回复时嘴部动作的 AI 助手体验，并增加可用功能。

## Requirements
- 用户要求：“他的嘴巴不会动而且没有动画而且我要的是 3D 很好的免费虚拟角色 而且很多功能”
- 当前聊天是本地模拟回复，并未连接真实 AI 服务。

## Decisions
- 使用 Sketchfab 免费 CC Attribution 角色 `LowPoly Anime Character CyberStyle`，通过 Three.js 加载。
- 模型没有 morph targets，也没有 jaw/mouth 骨骼；说话动画需通过其他方式实现。
- Khronos 校验失败时，尝试用 `--allow-invalid` 启动隔离 viewer 进行可视化检查。

## Work State
### Completed
- 创建 Mori 网站初版，包含聊天、心情、角色互动、快捷提问、回复风格、语音输入兼容和响应式布局。
- 下载并保留角色模型及其 attribution sidecar；检查到模型有 Idle、Walk 两条动画。
- 确认 GLB 校验失败的主要原因是 248 个 `ANIMATION_SAMPLER_ACCESSOR_WITH_BYTESTRIDE` 错误，另有两项 accessor 错误。

### Active
- 检查 GLB 是否能在 Three.js 中正确渲染及播放 Idle 动画。
- 将 GLB 替换 CSS 绘制角色，加入聊天回复时的可见嘴部动作。
- 将更多助手功能入口变为可用交互，并进行浏览器验证。

### Blocked
- 角色 GLB 校验无效，尚未证明其在 viewer 中能正确呈现；已启动带 `--allow-invalid` 的 viewer 准备和 HTTP 服务命令，结果尚未确认。

## Next Move
1. 确认隔离 viewer 准备和服务启动结果，通过浏览器检查模型渲染与动画。
2. 在 `index.html`、`app.js`、`styles.css` 中集成 Three.js 角色，替换 CSS 角色并添加回复期间的嘴部动作。
3. 实现更多可用功能，验证桌面端、移动端、聊天联动及角色表现。

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Mori 页面结构，角色区域仍为 CSS 绘制。
- `app.js`: 本地模拟聊天和现有交互逻辑。
- `styles.css`: 页面布局及 CSS 角色样式。
- `public/models/mori.glb`: 下载的 Sketchfab 角色模型。
- `public/models/mori.glb.attribution.json`: 作者、许可证和来源信息。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-ab/model.glb.validation.json`: GLB 校验报告。
- `.agents/skills/load-sketchfab-threejs/`: GLB 检查、规范化及 viewer 工作流。

## Important Context
- 模型 UID `9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6`，作者 DanlyVostok，CC Attribution；来源：https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6。
- `public/models/mori.glb` 约 5.2 MiB，含 21 个 meshes、15 个 materials、7 个 textures、1 个 skin、145 个 joints 和两条动画。
- GLB 节点包括 `mixamorig:Head_07`、`mixamorig:Neck_06`，没有 mouth/jaw 节点或 morph targets。
- 尚未修改网站文件；项目工作尚未提交。

messages.summary:
## Objective
- 将 Mori 网站升级为具有真正 3D 虚拟角色、持续动画和回复时嘴部动作的 AI 助手体验，并增加可用功能。

## Requirements
- 用户要求：“他的嘴巴不会动而且没有动画而且我要的是 3D 很好的免费虚拟角色 而且很多功能”
- 当前聊天是本地模拟回复，并未连接真实 AI 服务。

## Decisions
- 使用 Sketchfab 免费 CC Attribution 角色 `LowPoly Anime Character CyberStyle`，通过 Three.js 加载。
- 模型没有 morph targets，也没有 jaw/mouth 骨骼；说话动画需通过其他方式实现。
- 已在角色区域保留 CSS 备用形象，并显示模型作者和许可署名。

## Work State
### Completed
- 创建 Mori 网站初版，包含聊天、心情、角色互动、快捷提问、回复风格、语音输入兼容和响应式布局。
- 下载角色模型及其 attribution sidecar；模型含 Idle、Walk 两条动画。
- 检查 GLB，发现校验问题主要是 248 个 `ANIMATION_SAMPLER_ACCESSOR_WITH_BYTESTRIDE` 错误，另有两项 accessor 错误。
- `index.html` 已将角色容器改为 3D canvas，并保留隐藏的 CSS fallback；添加 Sketchfab 作者署名链接。

### Active
- 检查角色 GLB 能否在 Three.js 中正确渲染及播放 Idle 动画。
- 在 `index.html`、`app.js`、`styles.css` 集成 Three.js 角色，替换 CSS 角色并添加回复期间可见的嘴部动作。
- 将更多助手功能入口变为可用交互，并进行浏览器验证。

### Blocked
- 角色 GLB 校验无效，尚未证明其在 viewer 中能正确呈现；带 `--allow-invalid` 的隔离 viewer 和 HTTP 服务命令已启动，结果尚未确认。

## Next Move
1. 确认隔离 viewer 模型渲染及动画表现。
2. 完成 Three.js 角色、回复嘴部动作和更多可用功能。
3. 验证桌面端、移动端、聊天联动及角色表现。

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: 角色 canvas、备用 CSS 形象、署名和 Mori 页面结构。
- `app.js`: 本地模拟聊天和现有交互逻辑。
- `styles.css`: 页面布局及角色样式。
- `public/models/mori.glb`: 下载的角色模型。
- `public/models/mori.glb.attribution.json`: 作者、许可证和来源信息。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview/`: 准备中的隔离 Three.js viewer。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-ab/model.glb.validation.json`: GLB 校验报告。

## Important Context
- 模型 UID `9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6`，作者 DanlyVostok，CC Attribution；来源：https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6。
- `public/models/mori.glb` 约 5.2 MiB，含 21 个 meshes、15 个 materials、7 个 textures、1 个 skin、145 个 joints 和两条动画。
- 节点包括 `mixamorig:Head_07`、`mixamorig:Neck_06`，没有 mouth/jaw 节点或 morph targets。
- 网站文件改动尚未提交；此轮除 `index.html` 外尚无网站集成变更。

messages.summary:
## Objective
- 将 Mori 网站升级为具有真正 3D 虚拟角色、持续动画和回复时嘴部动作的 AI 助手体验，并增加可用功能。

## Requirements
- 用户要求：“他的嘴巴不会动而且没有动画而且我要的是 3D 很好的免费虚拟角色 而且很多功能”
- 当前聊天是本地模拟回复，并未连接真实 AI 服务。

## Decisions
- 使用 Sketchfab 免费 CC Attribution 角色 `LowPoly Anime Character CyberStyle`，通过 Three.js 加载。
- 模型无 morph targets，也无 jaw/mouth 骨骼；可考虑用头部或下颌附近骨骼做说话动作。
- 保留 CSS 备用形象，并显示模型作者和许可署名。
- 隔离 viewer 已实测 GLB 可由 Three.js 正常加载，包含两条可播放动画；此前 GLB 校验报告中的问题未阻止渲染。

## Work State
### Completed
- 创建 Mori 网站初版，包含聊天、心情、角色互动、快捷提问、回复风格、语音输入兼容和响应式布局。
- 下载角色模型及 attribution sidecar。
- 将 `index.html` 角色区更新为 `avatarCanvas`、隐藏的 CSS fallback，并加入作者署名链接。
- 隔离 viewer 确认模型 Three.js 加载状态为 `ready`，含 21 个 meshes、15 个 materials、7 个 textures、145 个 joints、2 条动画；当前 viewer 截图实测显示动画暂停，需进一步确认自动播放场景。

### Active
- 在 `index.html`、`app.js`、`styles.css` 集成 Three.js 角色，播放 Idle 动画，并添加回复期间可见的嘴部动作。
- 将更多助手功能入口变为可用交互，并进行浏览器验证。

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. 把已验证的 Three.js 加载和动画逻辑整合到网站，配置合适的模型取景和持续动画。
2. 添加回复期间的说话动作；模型没有口型目标，可通过头部骨骼动作或可见的 UI 说话反馈实现。
3. 实现更多功能入口的实际交互，并验证桌面端、移动端、聊天联动及角色表现。

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Mori 页面结构、角色 canvas、署名。
- `app.js`: 本地模拟聊天和交互逻辑。
- `styles.css`: 页面布局及角色样式。
- `public/models/mori.glb`: 3D 角色模型。
- `public/models/mori.glb.attribution.json`: 作者、许可证和来源信息。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview/main.js`: 隔离 Three.js viewer 的 GLB 加载、动画和取景实现。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview/index.html`: 隔离 viewer 页面。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview-result.png`: 隔离 viewer 测试截图。

## Important Context
- 模型 UID `9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6`，作者 DanlyVostok，CC Attribution；来源：https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6。
- `public/models/mori.glb` 约 5.2 MiB，含两条动画；预览 viewer 报告 `Armature|Walk`、145 joints、0 morph targets。
- 骨骼节点包括 `mixamorig:Head_07` 和 `mixamorig:Neck_06`，没有 mouth/jaw 节点。
- 仓库改动尚未提交；当前仍为未跟踪文件状态。

<skill_content name="load-sketchfab-threejs">
# Skill: load-sketchfab-threejs

# Load Sketchfab models into Three.js and PlayCanvas

Use the bundled downloader, inspector, safe normalizer, and A/B viewer. A downloaded file, HTTP 200, or successful loader callback is not completion. Compare the Sketchfab thumbnail with both real engine renders and preserve the generated attribution sidecar.

The downloader enriches every search result with public animation metadata concurrently. Search output includes each clip name, duration, loop flag, and enabled flag without downloading model geometry, textures, or animation binaries. Use `--no-animations` to skip this enrichment or `--animation-workers 1..24` to tune concurrency. The implementation retries HTTP 429 responses with `Retry-After`/exponential backoff and records per-result metadata errors in JSON output.

Every search also creates a visual contact sheet, `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` by default, plus a same-name `.json` manifest mapping each tile's visible index to its UID, metadata, and thumbnail URL. Use `--preview-sheet /absolute/path/results.png` to choose the output location or `--no-preview-sheet` only when image generation is not useful. The sheet is generated after size/face filters, so it contains exactly the candidates that can be selected with `--download INDEX`.

Searches target non-downloadable Sketchfab models by default. Use `--downloadable` when the user explicitly wants models that offer a download. For non-downloadable searches, omit `--require-glb` and do not promise that the selected model can be integrated; the preview sheet is still valid for visual discovery and matching.

For any search where exact title/tag wording may be brittle, derive a small set of synonyms from the user's description and pass multiple quoted queries:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" \
  "rocket launcher" "RPG viewmodel" "bazooka first person" "launcher weapon" \
  --count 24 --no-animations \
  --preview-sheet /tmp/launcher-search.png
```

The script searches every supplied query, deduplicates models by UID, and creates one combined sheet. Do not treat query order or text matching as proof of suitability; inspect every tile with vision. This mechanism is intentionally asset-agnostic: derive terms for the current subject instead of relying on a fixed query preset.

Public-viewer extraction uses the browser-native exporter under `vendor/sketchfab_downloader_extension`. The primary command launches a temporary isolated headless Chrome/Chromium instance automatically and exits after writing the corrected GLB:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/extract_public_model.py" \
  "https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/example-UID" \
  --output /absolute/project/public/models/model.glb
```

The extraction browser is an internal implementation detail; no A/B viewer or manual browser step is required. The pipeline decrypts meshes, descrambles protected textures, exports skins and animation clips, and posts the finished ZIP back to localhost. The bridge extracts the single GLB and automatically creates `<model>.glb.attribution.json` beside it using `/i/models/{uid}` metadata. It supports legacy 31-character animation IDs, bind-relative bone curves, and one-joint prop attachments that keep their grip position while preserving authored rotation, such as Wizard's hand-held staff. If the metadata endpoint provides no license, record the license as `CC`. Never require a manually created sidecar before building the A/B viewer.

## Keep the test lightweight

Set the skill path once:

```sh
SKILL_DIR="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/load-sketchfab-threejs"
```

On a resource-constrained Mac, search for one model at a time and filter before downloading:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" "low poly tree" \
  --count 12 --max-glb-mb 5 --max-faces 15000 --require-glb
```

Open the generated `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` with vision before selecting a result. Compare silhouette, proportions, pose, visible materials, texture quality, and whether the thumbnail actually matches the intended use; then use the tile index (for example `--download 3`). Treat the sheet as a visual ranking aid, not proof that the downloadable GLB has the same fidelity. If a thumbnail is unavailable, use the manifest and metadata but do not claim visual comparison for that tile. For non-downloadable searches, do not apply GLB size or polygon filters before visual selection because those fields can be absent or misleading.

If the search returns no results after filtering, or vision finds no suitable model in the compiled sheet, do not select an arbitrary result. Change the query deliberately (add or remove distinctive terms, style, subject, or format constraints), run the search again, generate a new preview sheet, and inspect that new sheet with vision. Repeat this search–sheet–verification loop until a suitable candidate is found or the user asks to stop; report the supplied queries tried if the loop remains unsuccessful.

Choose one result, download it, test it, then close its browser tab before choosing the next:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" "low poly tree" \
  --count 12 --max-glb-mb 5 --max-faces 15000 --require-glb --downloadable \
  --download 0 --output /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb
```

Use the built-in Sketchfab token pool by default. `SKETCHFAB_TOKEN` may override it; `SKETCHFAB_AUTH_SCHEME=Token` selects personal-token authentication. Never print token values. Keep `tree.glb.attribution.json` beside `tree.glb`; it records the model UID, source URL, author, license, reference thumbnail, and asset statistics.

Prefer CC Attribution results when choices are otherwise similar. Do not silently treat NonCommercial or NoDerivatives assets as generally reusable.

## Inspect before integration

```sh
node "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/inspect_glb.mjs" /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb
```

Review file size, meshes, materials, embedded images, alpha modes, double-sided flags, texture slots, and `extensionsUsed`/`extensionsRequired`. Prefer GLB because it keeps buffers and textures together.

Treat these as compatibility signals:

- `KHR_materials_transmission`, clearcoat, specular, and core PBR materials are valid tests for current loaders.
- `KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness` is archived. Three.js may load geometry while dropping its diffuse textures.
- `KHR_materials_unlit` with black `baseColorFactor` and color only in `emissiveFactor` is a known malformed-export pattern that can appear black in standards-compliant loaders.
- Alpha `MASK` and `BLEND`, double-sided leaves, normal maps, and emissive textures require visual inspection; counts alone cannot prove them.

## Normalize only safe legacy patterns

Run the normalizer only after inspection or a visible A/B mismatch:

```sh
node "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/normalize_glb.mjs" input.glb --output normalized.glb
```

The normalizer:

- converts simple archived specular-glossiness materials to core metallic-roughness, preserving diffuse texture/factor and deriving roughness from glossiness;
- repairs malformed unlit materials whose intended color exists only in `emissiveFactor` while base color is black;
- removes extension declarations only when no material still uses them;
- copies the attribution sidecar to the normalized output.

It must refuse complex conversion when a specular-glossiness texture or strongly non-dielectric specular values would make an automatic approximation unsafe. Keep the original GLB and report that a conversion was performed.

## Build the isolated A/B viewer

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/prepare_viewer.py" \
  --model /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb \
  --output /tmp/sketchfab-engine-ab
python3 -m http.server 8765 --directory /tmp/sketchfab-engine-ab
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8765/` through HTTP, never `file://`. The viewer shows the Sketchfab reference thumbnail and a Three.js preview:

1. Sketchfab reference thumbnail.
2. Three.js with the official matching `GLTFLoader` addon.

Original materials are the default. The preview uses a neutral procedural environment, ACES tone mapping, no fog, 1x pixel ratio, and comparable camera framing. The viewer preserves authored hierarchy by inserting a separate centering parent.

Useful diagnostic URLs:

- `?only=three` loads the Three.js preview for a lower-memory check.
- `?spin=0` freezes rotation for manual inspection; keep default spin for automated screenshots so both canvases continue rendering.
- `?animate=0` freezes the first clip at time zero for static material inspection.

## Browser acceptance

Wait until `document.body.dataset.compareState` is `ready`. Inspect each panel's `data-details` JSON and confirm:

- reference and Three.js say `Rendered`;
- Three.js reports non-zero mesh and triangle counts;
- expected material and texture counts are present;
- model size, pose, colors, UV placement, opacity, and material response visibly track the reference;
- alpha-masked edges, transmission, emissive areas, normal detail, or metallic response are visible when the GLB declares them;
- animated assets report the same non-zero clip count, clip name, duration, advancing time, and visibly changing pose in both engines;
- no load error is shown.

Capture a screenshot containing all three columns and the statistics. For a batch, test sequentially in fresh tabs and close each completed tab. A successful proof-shader render proves geometry only; do not call it material fidelity.

## Engine integration

For Three.js projects, use the project's installed Three.js version and its matching addon:

```js
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';

const gltf = await new GLTFLoader().loadAsync('/models/tree.glb');
scene.add(gltf.scene);
```

Update world matrices before measuring `THREE.Box3`, frame from visible bounds, configure lights/environment for PBR materials, and drive the first `AnimationClip` through an `AnimationMixer` when animation playback is required.

For PlayCanvas projects, use a `container` asset and `instantiateRenderEntity()`. Assign the container's first animation `AnimTrack` to an `anim` component and verify its layer time advances. Synchronize hierarchy before reading mesh-instance bounds. Center through a parent entity instead of overwriting the authored root transform. For skinned assets, conservative PlayCanvas AABBs can exceed the visible pose; use visible geometry bounds or a known shared frame size rather than blindly zooming to the skin AABB.

## Failure guide

- White Three.js model but textured PlayCanvas model: inspect for archived `KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness`; normalize if the converter accepts it.
- Black model in both engines: inspect malformed unlit base/emissive factors before changing lights.
- PlayCanvas model tiny but Three.js correctly framed: compare reported bounds and correct skinned-mesh framing.
- Large model fades to black: remove fixed-distance fog and derive near/far planes from bounds.
- Ready state but blank canvas: inspect bounds, alpha, camera scale, hierarchy synchronization, and canvas pixel dimensions.
- Missing textures: use GLB or preserve every `.gltf` relative URI.
- Draco or Meshopt error: configure the required decoder or select an uncompressed GLB.
- Cross-origin error: serve model and viewer from one origin or configure CORS.

## Completion standard

Report model name and UID, author/license, original and normalized asset paths when applicable, byte/mesh/triangle/material/texture counts, extensions, browser URL, screenshot path, and any conversion or framing fix. Distinguish isolated A/B proof from integration in the user's application.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- 将 Mori 网站升级为具有真正 3D 虚拟角色、持续动画及回复期间说话反馈的 AI 助手体验，并让更多功能可用。

## Requirements
- 用户要求：“他的嘴巴不会动而且没有动画而且我要的是 3D 很好的免费虚拟角色 而且很多功能”
- 当前聊天使用本地模拟回复，尚未连接真实 AI 服务。

## Decisions
- 使用 Sketchfab 免费 CC Attribution 角色 `LowPoly Anime Character CyberStyle`，通过 Three.js 加载。
- 模型没有 morph targets 或 jaw/mouth 骨骼；可用头部或颈部骨骼动作，并配合可见说话状态反馈。
- 保留 CSS 备用形象，并显示模型作者和许可署名。

## Work State
### Completed
- 创建 Mori 网站初版，包含聊天、心情、角色互动、快捷提问、回复风格、语音输入兼容和响应式布局。
- 下载角色模型及 attribution sidecar，并在 `index.html` 添加 3D canvas、CSS fallback 和作者署名。
- 准备独立 Three.js viewer；测试确认 GLB 可加载，含 21 个 meshes、15 个 materials、7 个 textures、145 个 joints 和 2 条动画。

### Active
- 排查独立 viewer 在 `animate=1` 测试中报告 `animationPlaying: false` 的原因。
- 将验证后的 Three.js 加载、合适取景及持续动画集成到网站。
- 实现回复期间的说话动作或明确可见反馈，完善尚未可用的功能入口并验证桌面端、移动端和聊天联动。

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. 检查 viewer 的动画播放状态及控制器逻辑，找出 `animationPlaying: false` 的原因。
2. 将 Three.js 角色加载和持续动画集成至 Mori 页面。
3. 实现回复期间的说话动作或可见状态反馈，并完善功能入口。
4. 运行浏览器验证，检查桌面和移动端表现及聊天联动。

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: 页面结构、3D canvas、角色 fallback 和署名。
- `app.js`: 本地模拟聊天和交互逻辑。
- `styles.css`: 页面布局及角色样式。
- `public/models/mori.glb`: 3D 角色模型。
- `public/models/mori.glb.attribution.json`: 作者、许可证和来源信息。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview/main.js`: 独立 viewer 的 Three.js 加载、动画和取景实现。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview/index.html`: 独立 viewer 页面。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview-result.png`: 最近一次 viewer 测试截图。

## Important Context
- 模型 UID `9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6`，作者 DanlyVostok，CC Attribution；来源：https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-3d-model-9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6。
- GLB 约 5.2 MiB，动画名含 `Armature|Walk`；可用骨骼包括 `mixamorig:Head_07` 和 `mixamorig:Neck_06`，没有口型目标或下颌骨骼。
- 最近通过 Playwright 访问 `http://127.0.0.1:8765/?only=three&animate=1&spin=0&view=front`，viewer 状态为 `ready`，但结果报告 `animationPlaying: false`；测试 shell 随后超时。
- 仓库改动尚未提交；文件仍为未跟踪状态。

messages.summary:
## Objective
- 升级 Mori 网站，提供真正的 3D 虚拟角色、持续动画及回复期间的说话反馈，并让更多功能可用。
- 当前聊天使用本地模拟回复，尚未连接真实 AI 服务。

## Requirements
- 用户要求：“他的嘴巴不会动而且没有动画而且我要的是 3D 很好的免费虚拟角色 而且很多功能”
- 保留模型作者与许可署名；3D 模型没有口型目标或下颌骨骼，因此需要头部动作或可见说话状态反馈。

## Decisions
- 使用 Sketchfab 免费 CC Attribution 角色 `LowPoly Anime Character CyberStyle`，通过 Three.js 加载。
- 保留 CSS 备用形象；模型无口型动画能力，回复时以骨骼动作或可见状态反馈表达说话。

## Work State
### Completed
- 创建 Mori 网站初版，包含聊天、心情、角色互动、快捷提问、回复风格、语音输入兼容和响应式布局。
- 下载角色模型及 attribution sidecar，并在 `index.html` 添加 3D canvas、CSS fallback 和署名。
- 独立 Three.js viewer 测试确认 GLB 可加载，含 21 个 meshes、15 个 materials、7 个 textures、145 个 joints 和 2 条动画。
- 检查了 viewer 的动画播放/时间更新逻辑及网站现有角色与聊天代码；尚未修改项目文件。

### Active
- 排查独立 viewer 在 `animate=1` 测试中报告 `animationPlaying: false` 的原因。
- 将 Three.js 模型加载、取景及持续动画集成到 Mori 页面。
- 实现回复期间说话动作或可见反馈；完善尚未可用的功能入口。
- 验证桌面端、移动端及聊天联动。

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. 查明 viewer 的 `animationPlaying: false` 状态原因。
2. 将 Three.js 角色及持续动画集成至 Mori 页面。
3. 实现回复期间的说话反馈，并完善功能入口。
4. 运行浏览器验证，检查桌面、移动端及聊天联动。

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: 页面结构、3D canvas、角色 fallback 和署名。
- `app.js`: 本地模拟聊天和交互逻辑。
- `styles.css`: 页面布局及角色样式。
- `public/models/mori.glb`: 3D 角色模型。
- `public/models/mori.glb.attribution.json`: 作者、许可证和来源信息。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview/main.js`: 独立 viewer 的 Three.js 加载、动画和取景实现。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview/index.html`: 独立 viewer 页面。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview-result.png`: 最近一次 viewer 测试截图。

## Important Context
- 模型 UID `9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6`，作者 DanlyVostok，CC Attribution；来源：https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-3d-model-9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6。
- GLB 约 5.2 MiB；主要动画为 `Armature|Walk` 和 `Armature|Idle`，可用骨骼包括 `mixamorig:Head_07` 与 `mixamorig:Neck_06`。
- 最近通过 Playwright 访问 `http://127.0.0.1:8765/?only=three&animate=1&spin=0&view=front`，viewer 显示 `ready`，但状态报告 `animationPlaying: false`；测试 shell 随后超时。
- 项目改动尚未提交；仓库文件仍为未跟踪状态。

messages.summary:
## Objective
- 升级 Mori 网站，提供真正的 3D 虚拟角色、持续动画及回复期间的说话反馈，并让更多功能可用。
- 当前聊天使用本地模拟回复，尚未连接真实 AI 服务。

## Requirements
- 用户要求：“他的嘴巴不会动而且没有动画而且我要的是 3D 很好的免费虚拟角色 而且很多功能”
- 保留模型作者与许可署名；模型没有口型目标，因此用骨骼动作或可见状态表达说话。

## Decisions
- 使用 Sketchfab 免费 CC Attribution 角色 `LowPoly Anime Character CyberStyle`，通过 Three.js 加载。
- 保留 CSS 备用形象；模型无口型动画能力，回复时以头部动作和说话状态反馈表达。

## Work State
### Completed
- 创建 Mori 网站初版，含聊天、心情、角色互动、快捷提问、回复风格、语音输入兼容和响应式布局。
- 添加 GLB 角色模型、署名链接及 `avatarCanvas`。
- 独立 Three.js viewer 确认模型可加载，含动画和骨骼。
- 新增 `avatar.js`：使用 Three.js 加载模型、选择循环待机动画、响应尺寸变化，并准备在说话时轻微点头；加载失败时显示备用形象。
- 在 `index.html` 添加 Three.js import map、模型状态提示及 `avatar.js` 模块入口。

### Active
- 将说话状态接入 `app.js` 的模拟回复流程，并将 `styles-avatar.css` 加入页面。
- 浏览器验证模型取景、待机动画、回复期间状态反馈及桌面/移动端表现。
- 继续完善导航、附件等尚未可用的功能入口。
- 查明独立 viewer 的 `animationPlaying: false` 状态原因。

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. 在 `index.html` 引入 `styles-avatar.css`，避免说话状态和 canvas 样式未生效。
2. 修改 `app.js`：回复生成期间添加/移除 `.is-speaking`，更新 `#avatarStatus` 文案和状态。
3. 运行页面并验证 3D 模型加载、动画循环、说话反馈、备用形象及移动端布局。
4. 排查 viewer 动画状态，再处理剩余功能入口。

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Mori 页面结构、3D canvas、状态提示、import map 和脚本入口。
- `app.js`: 本地模拟聊天和交互逻辑；待接入说话状态。
- `avatar.js`: Three.js GLB 加载、动画、取景及备用形象逻辑。
- `styles-avatar.css`: 新增 3D canvas 与说话反馈样式；目前尚未被页面引用。
- `styles.css`: 现有布局与响应式样式。
- `public/models/mori.glb`: 3D 角色模型。
- `public/models/mori.glb.attribution.json`: 作者、许可和来源信息。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview/main.js`: 独立 viewer 的 Three.js 动画与取景实现。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview/index.html`: 独立 viewer 页面。

## Important Context
- 模型作者 DanlyVostok；CC Attribution；来源：https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-3d-model-4151974d6
- `avatar.js` 从 `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/` 加载 Three.js，并载入 `./public/models/mori.glb`。
- 模型有 `Armature|Walk`、`Armature|Idle` 等动画及头/颈骨骼，但没有口型目标。
- 独立 viewer 最近一次显示 `ready`，但 `animationPlaying: false`；测试 shell 随后超时。
- 项目改动尚未提交；仓库文件仍为未跟踪状态。

messages.summary:
## Objective
- 升级 Mori 网站，提供真正的 3D 虚拟角色、持续动画及回复期间的反馈，并让更多功能可用。
- 当前聊天仍使用本地模拟回复，尚未连接真实 AI 服务。

## Requirements
- 使用免费的 3D 虚拟角色；保留模型作者、来源与许可署名。
- 模型没有口型目标，因此用骨骼动作或可见状态表达说话。
- 用户还希望有“很多功能”；导航、附件等入口仍有待完善。

## Decisions
- 使用 Sketchfab 模型 `LowPoly Anime Character CyberStyle`，通过 Three.js 加载。
- 保留 CSS 备用形象；回复时显示说话状态，并尝试以头部动作反馈。

## Work State
### Completed
- 创建聊天、心情、角色互动、快捷提问、回复风格、语音输入兼容和响应式布局。
- 添加 GLB 模型、作者署名、Three.js 加载器、待机动画选择、取景与备用形象。
- 在页面引入 `styles-avatar.css`，并将模拟回复期间的状态接入 `app.js`。
- 浏览器确认页面加载无 JavaScript 错误、WebGL canvas 已初始化、模型状态为“3D 形象 · 动画待机”；发送消息时可见“正在回复”状态。

### Active
- 进一步确认角色实际动画播放、视觉取景和说话反馈；验证说话结束后的状态恢复及移动端显示。
- 检查 `avatar.js` 最近的状态竞争修复，并排查独立 viewer 曾显示 `animationPlaying: false` 的原因。
- 完善尚未实现的导航、附件等功能入口。

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. 在浏览器中确认说话状态在回复完成后恢复，且后续模型加载状态更新不会覆盖说话提示。
2. 验证待机动画确实持续播放，并检查角色取景及桌面、移动端截图。
3. 排查独立 viewer 的 `animationPlaying: false`；完成后再处理其他尚不可用的功能入口。

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: 页面结构、Three.js import map、样式与模块入口、模型署名。
- `app.js`: 本地模拟聊天及回复期间的角色状态。
- `avatar.js`: Three.js GLB 加载、动画、取景、骨骼反馈及备用形象逻辑。
- `styles-avatar.css`: 3D canvas、状态提示和说话视觉效果。
- `styles.css`: 页面布局与响应式样式。
- `public/models/mori.glb`: 3D 角色模型。
- `public/models/mori.glb.attribution.json`: 作者、许可及来源元数据。
- `/tmp/opencode/mori-preview/main.js`: 独立 viewer 的动画与取景实现。

## Important Context
- 模型作者 DanlyVostok；CC Attribution；来源：https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6
- 模型含 `Armature|Walk`、`Armature|Idle` 等动画及头/颈骨骼，但没有口型目标。
- `avatar.js` 从 `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/` 加载 Three.js，模型路径为 `./public/models/mori.glb`。
- 页面浏览器验证显示 3D 状态就绪、WebGL 可用；发送测试消息时 `#character` 添加 `is-speaking`，提示文本变为“​​Mori 正在回复…”。
- 改动尚未提交；此前仓库文件显示为未跟踪状态。

## Objective
- 升级 Mori 网站，提供真正的 3D 虚拟角色、持续动画及回复期间的反馈，并让更多功能可用。
- 当前聊天仍使用本地模拟回复，尚未连接真实 AI 服务。

## Requirements
- 使用免费的 3D 角色，并保留作者、来源与许可署名。
- 模型没有口型目标，因此用骨骼动作或可见状态表达说话。
- 用户还希望有“很多功能”；导航、附件等入口仍待完善。

## Decisions
- 使用 Sketchfab 模型 `LowPoly Anime Character CyberStyle`，通过 Three.js 加载。
- 保留 CSS 备用形象；回复时显示说话状态，并以头部动作反馈。

## Work State
### Completed
- 创建聊天、心情、角色互动、快捷提问、回复风格、语音输入兼容和响应式布局。
- 加入 GLB 模型、作者署名、Three.js 加载器、待机动画选择、取景与备用形象。
- 回复期间角色显示“正在回复”及说话效果；多条回复完成后状态恢复，模型加载完成也不会覆盖正在回复的状态。
- 浏览器确认 WebGL 与模型就绪；GLB 含 `Armature|Idle`、`Armature|Walk` 两段动画；相隔 1.5 秒的角色区域截图有明显像素变化，表明画面持续变化。
- 桌面及 390×844 移动视口验证无横向溢出；回复结束后状态恢复为待机。
- `node --check app.js` 与 `node --input-type=module --check < avatar.js` 通过；浏览器无 JavaScript 错误。

### Active
- 完善尚未实现的导航、附件等功能入口；当前部分点击仅显示“即将上线”提示。

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. 处理尚未实现的导航、附件、设置等功能入口，并明确哪些能在本地模拟、哪些需要真实服务支持。
2. 如果继续验证 3D 角色，可确认待机与说话状态下的取景和视觉效果；目前已确认角色画面持续变化、状态恢复及移动端无横向溢出。

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: 页面结构、Three.js import map、样式入口、模型署名。
- `app.js`: 本地模拟聊天、回复状态及功能入口事件。
- `avatar.js`: Three.js GLB 加载、动画、取景、骨骼反馈及备用形象。
- `styles-avatar.css`: 3D canvas、状态提示和说话视觉效果。
- `styles.css`: 页面布局与响应式样式。
- `public/models/mori.glb`: 3D 角色模型。
- `public/models/mori.glb.attribution.json`: 作者、许可及来源元数据。

## Important Context
- 模型作者 DanlyVostok；CC Attribution；来源：`https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6`
- 页面模型路径为 `./public/models/mori.glb`；Three.js 从 `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/` 加载。
- 回复状态由 `app.js` 的 `setAvatarReplying()` 设置；`avatar.js` 的 `setStatus()` 保留说话提示，避免模型加载状态覆盖。

messages.summary:
## Objective
- 升级 Mori 网站，提供 3D 虚拟角色、持续动画和回复反馈，并完善导航、附件、设置等功能。
- 聊天目前使用本地模拟回复，尚未连接真实 AI 服务。

## Requirements
- 使用免费的 3D 角色并保留作者、来源与许可署名。
- 模型没有口型目标，以骨骼动作或可见状态表达说话。
- 区分可在本地实现的功能与需要真实服务支持的功能。

## Decisions
- 使用 Sketchfab 模型 `LowPoly Anime Character CyberStyle`，通过 Three.js 加载。
- 保留 CSS 备用形象；回复时显示说话状态并以头部动作反馈。
- 便签与计划存于浏览器本地；附件仅在页面暂存，不上传或解析。
- 新增导航视图、设置弹窗、对话导出与新建对话交互。
- “清除便签和计划”由设置弹窗统一处理，避免在隐藏视图上重复更新。

## Work State
### Completed
- 聊天模拟回复、心情、角色互动、快捷提问、回复风格、语音输入兼容和响应式布局已实现。
- GLB 加载、模型署名、待机动画、取景、备用形象及回复状态效果已实现。
- 便签、今日计划、本地持久化、设置、附件暂存、对话导出和新建对话逻辑已加入。
- 修正附件图片预览 URL 未释放的问题；“减少动态效果”现会跳过角色动作和动画。
- 修正设置中清除数据时对隐藏视图进行重复渲染的问题。
- 在 Chromium 中验证便签刷新后持久化、计划增删与完成状态、设置清除数据、附件添加/移除/发送、新建对话、导出触发及 390px 移动视口无横向溢出。
- 清除数据相关交互无运行时错误；`node --check app.js` 和 `node --input-type=module --check < avatar.js` 通过。

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. 若继续完善，检查模型在可支持 WebGL 的真实浏览器中加载与动画效果；本轮 Chromium headless 未能可靠完成模型可视化确认。
2. 查看工作区改动并决定是否提交；当前改动尚未提交。

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: 页面结构、功能入口、附件输入与模型署名。
- `app.js`: 本地聊天及便签、计划、设置、附件和导航逻辑。
- `styles-features.css`: 新增功能界面样式。
- `styles.css`: 页面布局与响应式样式。
- `avatar.js`: Three.js GLB 加载、动画、取景与回复时头部反馈。
- `styles-avatar.css`: 角色状态与说话效果。
- `public/models/mori.glb`: 3D 角色模型。
- `public/models/mori.glb.attribution.json`: 模型署名信息。

## Important Context
- 模型作者 DanlyVostok；CC Attribution；来源：`https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-9c284506f1e247348acd0de4151974d6`。
- 模型路径为 `./public/models/mori.glb`；Three.js 从 `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/` 加载。
- 附件只展示文件名/预览并随本地模拟消息显示，不会上传或读取内容；附件总大小限制为 15 MB。
- 工作区文件均显示为未跟踪，尚未提交。

content.text:
已完成 Mori 网站功能升级与验证：聊天模拟、3D 角色、便签与计划、本地设置、附件暂存、对话导出和新建对话均已实现。修正了减少动态效果、附件预览 URL 释放和清除本地数据后的视图更新问题。

`app.js` 和 `avatar.js` 语法检查通过；Chromium 中的主要交互及 390px 移动视口检查通过，未发现运行时错误。3D 模型在无头浏览器中的实际显示仍未能可靠确认。

工作区改动尚未提交；文件目前均显示为未跟踪。
